related.title: NUMA First-touch：資料放置與遠端讀取
related.titleEn: NUMA first-touch: placement and remote reads
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付SIMD吞吐算式、編譯證據與執行條件表；48/38.4正確且標理想值，部署前核對所需ISA與作業系統支援；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver SIMD arithmetic, compiler evidence and execution prerequisites. Verify 48/38.4 as ideal values and check required ISA/OS support before deployment. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 畫初始化執行緒、頁面歸屬與消費執行緒；first-touch不是程序建立時自動平均分散；95/86重現，頁面與工作映射可追蹤，未以延遲平均預測所有快取行為。
related.differenceEn: Map initializer, page ownership and consuming threads; first-touch is not automatic even distribution at process creation. Reproduce 95/86 with traceable pages/work, without extending the average to all cache behavior.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 簡化吞吐R=lane×每laneFLOP×每週期向量數×GHz；只作理想算術上限；FP64八lane、FMA每lane2FLOP、每週期1向量；有效3.0GHz對2.4GHz；名義式 8*2*1*3 = 48 GFLOP/s/core ideal；變更式 8*2*1*2.4 = 38.4 GFLOP/s/core ideal。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
平均延遲L=p×Llocal+(1−p)×Lremote，假設存取可分別計數且無重疊；本地80ns、遠端140ns；本地比例p=.75，改善到.9；名義式 .75*80+.25*140 = 95 ns/access model；變更式 .9*80+.1*140 = 86 ns/access model。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Simplified throughput R=lanes×FLOP/lane×vectors/cycle×GHz, an ideal arithmetic bound only. FP64 eight lanes, FMA 2 FLOP/lane, one vector/cycle; effective 3.0 versus 2.4 GHz. Nominal 8*2*1*3 = 48 GFLOP/s/core ideal; changed 8*2*1*2.4 = 38.4 GFLOP/s/core ideal. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

Average latency L=pLlocal+(1−p)Lremote, assuming countable independent accesses with no overlap. Local 80 ns, remote 140 ns; local share 0.75 then 0.9. Nominal .75*80+.25*140 = 95 ns/access model; changed .9*80+.1*140 = 86 ns/access model. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: BLAS DGEMM：轉置契約與行列索引
related.titleEn: BLAS DGEMM: transpose contracts and matrix indices

related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver SIMD arithmetic, compiler evidence and execution prerequisites. Verify 48/38.4 as ideal values and check required ISA/OS support before deployment. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 畫A列、B欄與C元素，註明row-major或column-major介面和leading dimension單位；27/22與手算一致，矩陣形狀、轉置旗標及stride可重建。
related.differenceEn: Draw A row, B column and C element, labeling layout and leading-dimension units. Verify 27/22 and reconstruct shapes, transpose flags and strides.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 簡化吞吐R=lane×每laneFLOP×每週期向量數×GHz；只作理想算術上限；FP64八lane、FMA每lane2FLOP、每週期1向量；有效3.0GHz對2.4GHz；名義式 8*2*1*3 = 48 GFLOP/s/core ideal；變更式 8*2*1*2.4 = 38.4 GFLOP/s/core ideal。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
C=αAB+βC0；對同一元素先做內積，再套α與β，不能省略舊C項；A第一列[1,2]，B第一行向量列為[3,4]，C0(0,0)=5；α2，β1；改β0；名義式 2*(1*3+2*4)+1*5 = 27 C(0,0)；變更式 2*(1*3+2*4) = 22 C(0,0)。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Simplified throughput R=lanes×FLOP/lane×vectors/cycle×GHz, an ideal arithmetic bound only. FP64 eight lanes, FMA 2 FLOP/lane, one vector/cycle; effective 3.0 versus 2.4 GHz. Nominal 8*2*1*3 = 48 GFLOP/s/core ideal; changed 8*2*1*2.4 = 38.4 GFLOP/s/core ideal. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

C=αAB+βC 0; compute the dot product before applying α/β, and retain the old C term. A row 0=[1, 2], B column 0=[3, 4], C0(0, 0)=5, alpha 2, beta 1; compare beta 0. Nominal 2*(1*3+2*4)+1*5 = 27 C(0, 0); changed 2*(1*3+2*4) = 22 C(0, 0). Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
